what: Weighted silhouette IoU of the Postie Bike against its reference sheets (tools/vehicles/fit: side 0.4, top 0.3, front 0.15, rear 0.15). Before = the br-bwju.5 bake and after = this bake, both scored by the same evaluator in Playwright Chromium on eris, with the helmet-patched masks and the level far camera of refs/sheets.json (camD 30, tilt 0); under the old masks and the Cruz camera the br-bwju.5 bake scored 0.8126 / 0.7605 / 0.6742 at LOD0 / 1 / 2. before = before-br-bwju.5/score-lod<N>.json, after = reference-lod<N>/score.json. tris as the fit page counts them (the bake's own counts are 2782 / 894 / 586).
